description: The Pyramid Success — the friends, coaches, and teammates who shaped The Pyramid Principle.

quotes.body: “I don’t feel that you’re ready to leave the world yet, you have too much to accomplish and more to affect the world of cancer by living, rather than dying, and joining Erin.”
“If you are who you say you are, I'd like some of that.”
“Jesus please come into my life. I'm giving my life over to you.”

quotes.attribution: Erin Vallely before first cancer surgery

quotes.body: “God, where are you and why are we alone in this?”
quotes.attribution: prayer of John Vallely over Erin's cancer
Erin Vallely during intense pain of 2nd round of cancer.

quotes.body: “God is my hero. He prays for me all the time.”
quotes.attribution: 11-year-old Erin on card to her oncologist.
